proof_summary: For \(n=162178349052694\), the intermediate integer \(a(n)+4=1813934020268071832273\) lies strictly between the proposed consecutive pair. It is a Sierpiński number because the exponent classes \(0\bmod2,3\bmod4,1\bmod8,5\bmod16,29\bmod32,45\bmod48,29\bmod48,13\bmod96\) cover all exponents and make \(k2^e+1\) divisible respectively by \(3,5,17,257,65537,97,673,193\).
